description: Land Acquisition - Karasnagala, Attanagalla D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically declares that certain described lands are needed for a public purpose (construction of a Stores Building and workshop under a water supply scheme) and will be acquired. The content provides detailed descriptions of the land parcels, including lot numbers, names, extents, boundaries, and location details. This falls squarely under Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it deals with land acquisition matters.
